WITH units AS (
  SELECT 
    sf.sentreg,
    sf.instownpct,
    tr.ordertypedist
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals sf
  INNER JOIN transactionrecord tr ON sf.transref = tr.transreg
  WHERE tr.ordertypedist IS NOT NULL 
    AND sf.instownpct IS NOT NULL
),
mix_baselines AS (
  SELECT 
    ordertypedist,
    AVG(instownpct) as mix_avg
  FROM units
  GROUP BY ordertypedist
),
overall_stats AS (
  SELECT AVG(instownpct) as overall_avg
  FROM units
)
SELECT
  AVG(u.instownpct) as avg_kept_ownership,
  AVG(u.instownpct / mb.mix_avg) as avg_ratio_to_mix_baseline,
  AVG(u.instownpct - os.overall_avg) as avg_excess_over_overall
FROM units u
JOIN mix_baselines mb ON u.ordertypedist = mb.ordertypedist
CROSS JOIN overall_stats os
WHERE u.instownpct > os.overall_avg;

assumptions.assumption: Sentiment snapshots with NULL institutional ownership (instownpct) are excluded from all calculations, following the pattern of the explicit requirement to exclude units with no order type mix.
